answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The nectar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. A voyage of per-task receipts records who did what, and the meadow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
